points.text: Pages deploy no longer races the upload step. The workflow splits into an export job that builds and uploads the site artifact, then a deploy job that needs it and runs actions/deploy-pages. This avoids the intermittent 'No artifacts named github-pages' failure.

entries.summary: GitHub Pages deploy is reliable again after the export/deploy job split.
